mapper.select: SELECT T.* , R1.YIELD rangeYield FROM FIN_CASH_INFO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT B.FINPROD_ID, MIN(B.VDATE) vdate, B.MDATE mdate, MIN(B.VDATE_UNADJUST) vdateUnadjust, MIN(B.MDATE_UNADJUST) mdateUnadjust, MIN(B.VDATE_TERM) vdateTerm, MIN(B.MDATE_TERM) mdateTerm, SUM(B.PRIN_AMT) prinAmt, SUM(B.INT_AMT) intAmt, SUM(cash_amt) cashAmt FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN B WHERE B.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} GROUP BY b.FINPROD_ID, B.MDATE) T ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE R1 ON FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = R1.CASH_ID AND R1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND R1.EFF_DATE <= t.vdate WHERE FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE R2 WHERE R1.CASH_ID = R2.CASH_ID AND R1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND R2.EFF_DATE <= t.vdate AND R2.EFF_DATE > R1.EFF_DATE ) ORDER BY T.VDATE
